## F03 P00 v21 source-to-runtime dependency ruling — 3 November 2026 (source-linked, no mutation)

**Reconciled exact sources:** F03 [Draft #10631](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10631) head `d9e78dc6512bcc7c79de540fe8d69746801b93c7`; programme parent [#10617](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10617) head `b0d827361e7adc266079fa0501789fd005d0794c`; P00 frozen return [#10626](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10626) head `3f27e859438f5ba2d8288735c4d04aa087bfc45c`. Protected Mastermind `master@9f65957e29eba92245d78609f032aaea523b7cb4` was verified compatible with INDEX schema `mastermind.sol_skillpack.v1` 1.0.1/bootstrap 1.

**New accepted source fact; DO_NOT_REDO:** [Mastermind #1978](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Mastermind/pull/1978) v21 guarded-call requalification and [Mastermind #1982](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Mastermind/pull/1982) v20 multi-seat selector are both formally **MERGED**. The original P00 carrier's [protected-merge and exact original-host readback](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10626#issuecomment-6598824978) verifies that all ten affected source blob identities landed and were retained; do **not** reopen their accepted source merge/CI/review work.

**Distinct runtime truth:** P00's original M2 C2 LaunchAgent last selected a **v20** immutable Paper bridge (`1a73ab002e89c87b489e8cee9f5c821530929a5b701eb0aaac7eed03a5a22ced`), not merged v21 (`dfbf0b11c49a595610d1ac0e663d95f7291b500cb84d31ef8169bc3b909a2eaa`). I made a **read-only** `paper_inspect` call through the existing private Mastermind Paper app: `CONNECTED`, upstream Paper Desktop `0.5.18`; its foreground was a separate GMI Explorer file. This confirms app connectivity **only**, not the selected bridge revision, account-level v21 eligibility, permission for F03 target edits, or production acceptance. No target edit/prepare was attempted.

**F03 disposition: `P00_SOURCE_MERGE_COMPLETE / F03_PARTIAL_BLOCKED_RETURN`.** The F03 owner already preserved two page-label corrections, the corrected family directory and Terminal exact-reference board (50 author-recorded applied operations), without claiming 51 physical family moves, 301 proposed page actions, folder/archive/cross-file transfers, complete identity/preservation proof or RIG. Those unsupported operations remain held. P00's historical source-return `BLOCKED_RETURN/PARTIAL` is still accurate for the unproven runtime and does not become a completed F03 mutation dependency.

**Exact next existing-owner actions, not a new worker/commission:**
1. The original authorized Paper source/host owner alone stages/verifies and, **only with current action admission**, selects v21 on the **original** service/seat carrier; preserve exact source manifest, custody and effect guards. Do not restart/republish or switch accounts/carriers here.
2. That owner then obtains a current same-app v21 account/target-path readback and separately authorized safe real-path acceptance. An upstream catalog accepting 16 write schemas is **not** proof that unsupported folder/move/archive functions became available.
3. F03's existing source/Paper owner consumes the verified runtime receipt, updates **its existing** source ledger and action-by-action organization gates, and only then plans lawful new physical operations with exact file/board identities and full preservation check. Do not replay refused/unknown operations or overwrite already accepted disjoint boards. Requested independent reviewer `MastermindX1` remains unchanged.

**Non-effects of this note:** no Paper write, source code push, service cutover, new session/reviewer, PR review verdict, merge, Ready/un-draft, queue, label/hold change or deployment. F03 and parent remain Draft/HOLD.
